Review complete (`verdict: "approved"`, 0 findings).

- **Correctness:** All 6 units (`packages/excalidraw/lasso/utils.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/lasso/index.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/CHANGELOG.md`, `.gitignore`) implement `change_plan.md` accurately.
- **Type safety:** Explicit `"contain" | "overlap"` union typing and `isBoundToContainer` type guard used with zero `any` casts; `yarn test:typecheck` passes.
- **Error handling & edge cases:** Empty/missing segment arrays and standalone bound text elements with existing containers are safely guarded.
- **Test coverage:** Unit and end-to-end tests cover `"contain"` and `"overlap"` modes across rectangle, diamond, ellipse, rotated shape, line/arrow, freedraw, bound text, and rectangle box-selection regression (57 passed).
